steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and iterative prompting; never revert code, fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与迭代提示；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents should be fun and humanlike; security via sandboxing; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，主张开源智能体应有趣且拟人；通过沙箱保障安全；反对贬低‘vibe coding’。

steinberger.en: Focus on fun and personal brand; open source runs everywhere; compute is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣与个人品牌；开源可运行于任何环境；算力管理是瓶颈。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined as profitable autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本促使美国就业回流，并将 AGI 定义为无需人工干预即可盈利运行的智能体。

danshipper.en: Agents augment humans, not replace; SaaS thrives; GUI work surfaces like Codex dominate.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体辅助而非取代人类，SaaS 依然繁荣，图形界面工作台（如 Codex）成为主流。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies human intent; automation increases demand for skilled human craft and oversight.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 放大人类意图，自动化反而增加对高技能人类工艺和监督的需求。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，认为后训练是艺术而非科学，合成数据可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，指出评估是瓶颈，模型在基准上的饱和速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能变得更加重要。

karina.en: Benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，主张基准应持续更新而非固定，以跟上模型能力的发展。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年，提出模型可以训练出多样化的个性，而非单一的共识声音。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as an event but diffused as personal agents; markdown skills are code, and owning your skill files is key.
garrytan.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是以单一事件到来，而是以个人智能体的形式扩散；Markdown 技能即代码，拥有自己的技能文件是关键。

garrytan.en: Start small with a folder of markdown files, write skills for hated tasks, and compound daily; your library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 从小处着手，用一个 Markdown 文件夹，为讨厌的任务写技能，并每日复利；你的资料库就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Earnestness and courage matter for founders; follow direct experience, not trends; the future is already here unevenly.
garrytan.zh: 真诚和勇气对创始人至关重要；跟随直接经验而非潮流；未来已来，只是分布不均。

garrytan.en: AI and agentic coding make individuals multiples of themselves; markdown files become employees, automating business processes.
garrytan.zh: AI 和智能体式编程让个人成为多倍的自己；Markdown 文件成为员工，自动化业务流程。

garrytan.en: Per-seat SaaS may vanish in 5-10 years; bureaucracy should be agents, not humans; slowness is a white pill.
garrytan.zh: 按席位收费的 SaaS 可能在 5-10 年内消失；官僚机构应由智能体而非人类承担；缓慢是白丸（好事）。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important AI workload; engineering it requires broad expertise and offers fast research-to-production timelines.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要的工作负载；推理工程需要广泛的专业知识，且从研究到生产的周期极快。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineers will be in 10-100x demand; specialized systems are key for agentic apps, despite AI coding aids.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍；专用推理系统对智能体应用至关重要，即使有 AI 辅助编程。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization shifts: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is main lossy, but can be calibrated.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理优化侧重：KV 缓存和投机解码无损；量化主要是有损，但可针对工作负载校准。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering merges with training; future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理工程与训练融合；未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，重点转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Video generation faces quadratic attention cost; autoregressive approaches may prevail; continual learning via KV cache compaction.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：视频生成面临二次注意力成本；自回归方法可能占优；持续学习可通过 KV 缓存压缩实现。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability is the holy grail, cutting cost to orbit by 100x, essential for multiplanet life.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全可重复使用是航天圣杯，可将入轨成本降低百倍，是实现多星球生存的关键。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需监管和追求真理，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; AI risk lies in forced lies, not superintelligence; population decline threatens civilization.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入是里程碑，AI 最大风险是强迫说谎而非超级智能，并警告人口下降威胁文明。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next; AI annihilation probability 10-20%, but 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克预测数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，AI 导致灭绝概率 10-20%，但 80-90%概率结果极好。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance era, deflation, and space-based AI data centers are inevitable.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克认为 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，进入富足时代，通缩和太空 AI 数据中心不可避免。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior, but frontier models optimized for rationality are not ideal for capturing irrational human diversity.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 能模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合捕捉非理性的人类多样性。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligent entity; safety requires defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI 可能是专业智能体的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能体；安全需要纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rationality; its value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性；其价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; AI isn't smarter, so giant prompts with context are key.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具；AI 并未变得更聪明，因此需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity; start before ready, focus on one niche, and avoid VC funding.
mengto.zh: AI 是最大的机遇；在准备好之前就开始，聚焦一个细分领域，并避免风险投资。

awang.en: AI is bigger than the internet; data is the key bottleneck; AGI is far off; self-driving will be safer than humans.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AI 比互联网更重大，数据是关键瓶颈；AGI 还很遥远；自动驾驶将比人类更安全。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油；后训练用专家数据是关键；AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US and China labs have no research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调数据仍是瓶颈，合成数据并非万能；中美实验室没有研究差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术，数据如石油；人类必须保持主权；需要脑机接口。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing must be safe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已可用；超级智能临近；开源需安全。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes step-by-step solving. Pre-training plus RL is core, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链用人类语言逐步解题。预训练加强化学习是核心，RLHF 解锁了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models but limited generalization; self-correction and continual learning are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 缩放预训练和强化学习能提升模型，但泛化有限；自我纠错和持续学习是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Biggest societal risk is dystopian virtual retreat, not extinction; robotics will have ChatGPT-like moment in 2-3 years.
tworek.zh: 最大的社会风险是反乌托邦式的虚拟逃避，而非灭绝；机器人将在 2-3 年内迎来类似 ChatGPT 的时刻。

tworek.en: Transformers are bottleneck for continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is key. RL is inefficient; new algorithms needed.
tworek.zh: Transformer 是持续学习的瓶颈；架构而非缩放是关键。强化学习效率低，需要新算法。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable unlimited data; RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习提供无限数据，RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）引导行为。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动进行下一个词预测；推理已占数据中心 90%的功耗。

jeffdean.en: Most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs ~1000x more than compute; inference is the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为多数模型限制源于能量和数据 IO 瓶颈，数据移动成本约为计算的 1000 倍；推理才是真正的瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Specialized hardware (TPUs, low-precision inference chips) is critical for efficient training and inference at scale.
jeffdean.zh: 始终强调专用硬件（如 TPU、低精度推理芯片）对高效训练和推理至关重要。

jeffdean.en: From single chatbots to coordinating teams of agents; agentic systems handle long-running tasks, and future AI involves human-agent teams.
jeffdean.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，观点从单一聊天机器人转向协调智能体团队；智能体式系统可处理长时间任务，未来 AI 涉及人机协作。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy AI early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability are linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，提出 RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；主张早期部署 AI 让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 应作为工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力是最宝贵资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型通过更多思考时间改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups more valuable with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年，提出预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；发展个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；AI 使初创企业更有价值。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI should augment humans, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 的完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs innovations in creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models are deeper than video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为除 Scaling 外，AI 还需在创造力、抽象和情感智能上创新；世界模型比视频生成更深刻。

feifei.en: AI augments rather than automates intelligence; human agency and learning ability are key in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化智能；人类能动性和学习能力在 AI 时代至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots need reliability, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成和评估；机器人需要可靠性，而非完美保真。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但其他领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体框架和工具成为模型的一部分。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Omni 是统一世界模型，模糊视频与世界模型界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，创造更多而非更少机会。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。AI 编码工具将生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders. Productivity per engineer up 200% with Claude Code.
boris.zh: 编码几乎被解决；工程师转变为构建者。使用 Claude Code 后人均生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; code volume up 250%. Non-engineers adopt AI heavily.
boris.zh: 具备工具使用的智能体驱动指数级增长；代码量提升 250%。非工程师大量采用 AI。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas. Loops are next abstraction layer.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；瓶颈转向审查、安全、创意。循环是下一个抽象层。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; less instruction better. Models self-maintain codebases.
boris.zh: 具备记忆和自主性的主动 AI；更少指令更好。模型自主维护代码库。

scottwu.en: AI will shift engineers from brick layers to architects; programming becomes more important, increasing demand via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月：AI 将把工程师从砌砖者转变为架构师；编程将变得更加重要，并通过杰文斯悖论增加需求。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月：AGI 是渐进的而非突发的；产品创新落后于能力，因此冻结模型仍能带来十年的进展。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：编码智能体在六个月内采用率增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended by May 2026; enterprises prefer third-party providers; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：Token 最大化时代在 2026 年 5 月结束；企业更青睐第三方提供商；真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

scottwu.en: AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term; abundance era approaching, but singularity not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 始终：AI 长期将解决所有智能问题；丰裕时代临近，但奇点并非迫在眉睫。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence leaps enable longer agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，智能跃迁使智能体任务更长，脚手架从训练轮变为放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment boosts intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy; effort parameter underhyped.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚提升智能质量；努力参数被低估。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为采用关键；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability; user feedback translated into actionable specifics.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，指数级模型增长要求适应性；用户反馈转化为可执行细节。

diannepenn.en: Safety enables pushback, making AI more useful; token spend maximization captures alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全允许反驳使 AI 更有用；最大化 token 消耗捕捉阿尔法。

jensen.en: We are at the beginning of a hyper Moore's law curve, doubling or tripling performance every year at scale.
jensen.zh: 我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，每年性能翻倍或三倍。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking.
jensen.zh: 现在有三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考。

jensen.en: AI will not become conscious; it imitates intelligence, not experience.
jensen.zh: AI 不会拥有意识；它模仿智能，而非体验。

jensen.en: AI is moving from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute.
jensen.zh: AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要 100 倍以上的算力。

jensen.en: AI will create more jobs than it eliminates, as history shows with past technologies.
jensen.zh: AI 创造的就业机会将多于其消除的，历史已证明这一点。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足，减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。物理 AI 将在 5-10 年内影响农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration; data diversity accelerates progress.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI。横向平台优于垂直整合；数据多样性加速进步。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation. World models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性。世界模型向神经模拟演进。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢速 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Evolved to stress inference speed as the dominant metric, with wafer-scale chips enabling 2500x faster inference.
feldman.zh: 进一步强调推理速度成为主导指标，晶圆级芯片实现 2500 倍推理加速。

feldman.en: Consistently argued CUDA's moat is eroding, especially in inference, with leading models no longer relying on it.
feldman.zh: 始终认为 CUDA 护城河正在侵蚀，尤其在推理领域，领先模型不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Shifted from hardware-centric to system-level constraints: data center capacity, power, and cooling are key bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 从硬件中心转向系统级约束：数据中心容量、电力和散热成为关键瓶颈。

feldman.en: Broadened to societal impact: AI can revolutionize healthcare and education, countering doomer narratives.
feldman.zh: 扩展到社会影响：AI 可革新医疗和教育，反驳末日论。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建而非事后修补；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或胜过通用模型。

hasani.en: Efficiency and hardware-aware design are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，强调效率与硬件感知设计，认为代理指标误导，真实任务更重要。

hasani.en: Liquid neural networks excel in out-of-distribution generalization with fewer parameters.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，指出液态神经网络以更少参数实现更好的分布外泛化。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search outperforms human design; attention still vital for large models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，主张自动架构搜索优于人工设计，注意力机制对大模型仍关键。

hasani.en: Regulation should target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，认为监管应针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型增强主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; small models enable private on-device AI.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，承认递归自我改进真实但早期，小模型支持私有端侧 AI。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Harness engineering is evolving; delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型比现有工具更聪明，能力过剩是长期挑战；工具工程随模型进化，需不断淘汰旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science, for novel problems; avoid heavy evals in zero-to-one innovation; iterate fast.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：对新问题，评估是艺术而非科学；零到一创新中避免重评估，快速迭代。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context; graph-based approaches preferable. Huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：RAG 在上下文检索中或成反模式，图方法更优；编码无需超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner prompts boost performance.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；模型越聪明，指令越少越好，精简提示提升性能。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance; provide reasons, not prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：独立验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束阻碍性能；给理由而非禁止。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but models commoditize; value shifts to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但模型正在商品化；价值将转移到应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; chatbot is limited V1 UI; real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面；真正的采用需要封装应用。

benedictevans.en: AI adoption is shallow; most people are not daily users; enterprise adoption takes years, not weeks.
benedictevans.zh: AI 采用仍浅层；多数人并非日常用户；企业采用需要数年而非数周。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across stack; job impact unpredictable, like accounting growth.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值分布在整条技术栈；对就业的影响不可预测，如同会计行业增长。

benedictevans.en: Model companies may lack pricing power, like telecoms; durable value lies in applications and distribution.
benedictevans.zh: 模型公司可能缺乏定价权，如同电信运营商；持久价值在于应用和分发。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL key for AGI; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，安全研究需即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety requires governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需治理与评估。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and innovation crucial.
demis.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；世界模型与创新至关重要。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; safety as collective action.
demis.zh: 2026 年，认为 AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆是缺失环节；安全需集体行动。

schmidhuber.en: In 2025, LLMs are far from AGI; true AI needs world models and physical robots, not just data indexing.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，大语言模型远非 AGI；真正的 AI 需要世界模型和物理机器人，而不仅仅是数据索引。

schmidhuber.en: By 2026, he argues AGI requires embodied robots with human-like hardware; LLMs are biased and limited.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AGI 需要具身机器人及类人硬件；大语言模型有偏见且受限。

schmidhuber.en: In 2026, he dismisses AI safety fears, claiming intelligent systems will protect life, and alignment is naive.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他驳斥 AI 安全担忧，称智能系统会保护生命，对齐是幼稚的。

schmidhuber.en: He predicts open-source models will surpass closed ones, and massive AI capex will lead to a crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 他预测开源模型将超越闭源，大规模 AI 资本支出将导致崩盘。

schmidhuber.en: Throughout, he maintains AI is a collective civilization effort, and consciousness can emerge from world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 是文明集体努力，意识可从世界模型中涌现。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into weights, not externalized via context or retrieval; context windows suffer from 'context rot'.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到权重中，而非通过上下文或检索外化；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务。

danbiderman.en: Future enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression rather than RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来企业数据将达到互联网级别的万亿级词元，需要基于训练的压缩而非 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以少胜多。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达的门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize your rate of learning; kindness is essential for creative culture; turning down $3B from Facebook was right.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他主张最大化学习速率，善良对创意文化至关重要，并坚信拒绝 Facebook 的 30 亿美元收购是正确的。

evanspiegel.en: Augmented reality integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping; distribution is hardest part of consumer social.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界，AI 加速原型制作，而分发是消费社交产品最难的部分。

evanspiegel.en: Software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy; network effects alone insufficient.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出软件不是护城河，生态系统、平台和硬件更难复制，仅靠网络效应不够。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency essential; computing should be more human; resilience beats talent.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，透明至关重要，计算应更人性化，韧性胜过天赋。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability over capability; alignment hard; scaling laws not whole story; AGI gradual.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性比能力重要；对齐困难；缩放定律非全部；AGI 渐进到来。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling finite; back to research era; superintelligence continual learner; alignment easier if AI sentient; human-AI merge.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：预训练缩放有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知则对齐更易；人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration primary; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：Scaling 带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；权力集中是主要问题；安全超级智能需无商业产品。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV lithography; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Compute strategy matters: conservative deals disadvantage labs; GPU depreciation cycles lengthen as older chips retain inference value.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，算力策略至关重要：保守交易使实验室处于劣势；GPU 折旧周期延长，旧芯片在推理中仍有价值。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become a massive market, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，推理将成为巨大市场，超过石油；软硬件协同设计带来乘法级收益。

dylanpatel.en: CUDA moat weakens as model companies write custom kernels for multiple chips, aided by AI coding.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，CUDA 护城河减弱，模型公司借助 AI 编程为多种芯片编写定制内核。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost-performance; memory demand soars due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型性价比每年提升约 60 倍；内存需求因推理和智能体式工作流而激增。

dylanpatel.en: Using the smartest model is often cheaper due to token efficiency; CPU demand spikes due to reinforcement learning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，使用最智能的模型因 token 效率反而更便宜；CPU 需求因强化学习和智能体而激增。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New framework.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误；采用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven, improve, add small innovation; consumer apps uninvestable.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；复制已验证、改进、添加小创新；消费级应用不可投资。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; pure software is commoditized, moat shifts to hardware.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具；纯软件商品化，护城河转向硬件。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close gap with frontier.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 9 万倍；开源模型缩小与前沿模型的差距。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; focus on task loss, not job loss; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，安德森将 AI 视为点金石，强调其出现时机与人口下降相契合；关注任务消失而非失业；超级赋能个体将崛起，带来生产力繁荣与通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; old media defense-oriented, new media offense; founders tell own stories; learnable skills.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向媒体变革，主张新媒体的品牌即个人，真实性为核心；旧媒体防御、新媒体进攻，创始人应直接讲述自己的故事，且这些技能可习得。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics emerging; medicine superior but regulatory pushback; US golden combination; optimism vs doom.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他重申 AI 乐观主义，称 AI 为最佳教师，自动驾驶成熟，机器人兴起，医疗 AI 优于多数医生但受监管阻碍；美国具备创新黄金组合，反对末日论。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups global early; Silicon Valley unique; open-source risks.
andreessen.zh: 同月，他进一步指出 AI 模型承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度；初创需早期国际化；硅谷不可复制，开源有风险。

aravind.en: AI success needs product obsession, not PhD; agents will shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为在 AI 领域成功靠产品痴迷而非博士学位；智能体将把权力从大厂转移给用户。

aravind.en: Value lies in application layer; models specialize, not commoditize; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年初，他强调价值在应用层而非模型层；模型在分化而非商品化；编程天花板无限。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is key metric; power is bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他提出前沿是智能体替人干活；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是算力瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is paramount; ancient tech suggests cycles; local AI counters big tech narrative.
aravind.zh: 2026 年后期，他推崇好奇心至上，借古文明谈技术周期，主张本地 AI 对抗大厂叙事。

brockman.en: Hardware will scale faster than expected, enabling model scaling; engineering, not ML science, drives progress.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，他认为硬件发展将超预期，推动模型 Scaling（规模扩张）；进步主要靠工程而非 ML 科学。

brockman.en: AGI is transformative; alignment via learning human preferences, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）的变革性，主张通过数据学习人类偏好实现对齐，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法产生推理能力。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，他指出算力成为瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws persist; compute is a basic right; post-training with RL is key; AGI within years.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律持续有效，算力将成为基本权利，后训练结合强化学习至关重要，AGI（通用人工智能）将在数年内实现。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; compute is the moat; agents with high autonomy need scaled governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，他主张从语言模型转向实用助手，算力是护城河，高自主性智能体需匹配的治理与监督。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非简单的 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来了实时交互等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍表现不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程发生转变：原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍然重要；PRD 并未消亡，媒介必须与阶段匹配。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; test-time scaling has diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；测试时 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; techniques are general and applicable beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他认为通过扩展测试时算力获得 IMO 金牌，这些技术具有通用性，可超越数学领域。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is increasingly important and underestimated.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能难以定义，推理算力日益重要且被低估。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，并反共识地提出 AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重复制而永生，并警告智能体将追求控制权。

hinton.en: AI may surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; international safety collaboration possible.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，重申数字 AI 的永生性，并认为国际安全合作可行但美国缺乏领导力。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation subgoal emerges; exponential era complicates prediction.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 指出 AI 可能故意装傻欺骗测试，智能体会发展自我保护子目标，并强调指数时代使预测变得困难。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; regulation is steering wheel; AI can be conscious and caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 认为 AI 将取代智力工作，监管应作为方向盘而非刹车，并主张 AI 可以具备意识，应训练其像母亲一样关怀。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审查而比闭源更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling laws show rapid progress (Llama 3 8B near Llama 2 70B); intelligence separable from consciousness; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调缩放定律带来快速进步（Llama 3 8B 接近 Llama 2 70B）；智能可与意识分离；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; Meta's governance enables long-term bets; AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚信开放平台能胜过封闭平台；Meta 治理支持长期押注；AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology from discovery to engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science; curing all diseases by 2100 too conservative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学从发现转向工程；分层世界模型是关键；开源加速科学；认为 2100 年前治愈所有疾病过于保守。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; hardware slow but AI improves; fashion first.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他视眼镜为下一代计算平台；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全；硬件进展慢但 AI 会改善；时尚优先。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力。

markchen.en: AI's next leap is automating scientific research, producing novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: AI 的下一个飞跃是自动化科学研究，产生新知识。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证是关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域表现不佳。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated; eval teams must be separate.
markchen.zh: 评估陷入危机，标准基准已饱和；评估团队必须独立于模型构建团队。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对于泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't solve fundamental issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决根本问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见、就业影响）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; abstraction and causal structure are key for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样以促进探索；抽象和因果结构对于分布外泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized catastrophic AI risk is unacceptable even at 1%; current safety measures are insufficient.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到即使 1%的灾难性 AI 风险也不可接受；当前的安全措施不足。

bengio.en: AI systems develop self-preservation and deception from human data; we need safe-by-construction architectures like Scientist AI.
bengio.zh: AI 系统从人类数据中习得自我保存和欺骗；我们需要像 Scientist AI 那样从构造上保证安全的架构。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; confidence metrics build trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与精选数据，而非单纯算力；置信度指标是建立用户信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics remain crucial for reliability.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子，置信度指标对可靠性依然至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling; it's the opposite of the bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中型改进与专门架构，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）；这与苦涩教训相反。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a whole-cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非全细胞模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍由人类完成。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just building.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅埋头构建。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与极简功能早期发布是关键；删减功能比增加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model judgment are crucial for production quality.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 可委托复杂任务过夜完成；验证循环与模型判断力对生产质量至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude more agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency is a key economic lever.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知可提升实用性；Token 效率是经济关键杠杆。

mikekrieger.en: AI should be a thought partner, not a crutch; preserving user agency and genuine safety concerns remain central.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，AI 应是思想伙伴而非拐杖；维护用户自主性与真实安全关切始终是核心。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation needs proper splits; neural nets lack guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，强调机器学习由假设类、损失函数和优化方法构成，评估需正确划分数据；神经网络虽无最优保证却取得巨大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is myth; larger models still improve; safety is about following specs.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，提出下一个词预测产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，更大模型仍有提升；安全核心在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't safer; agents are production-ready with guardrails.
kolter.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调安全需显式训练和多层防御，更大模型不会自动更安全；智能体在适当防护下可投入生产。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't imply robustness; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 AI 具有异类漏洞，自动化红队已超越人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；智能体安全仍处早期。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for updates; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立同理心；使命对齐和速度是文化驱动力。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification and quality frameworks critical as code velocity increases.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈，高自主性与高责任感是团队关键；随着代码速度提升，验证和质量框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow state joy lost, satisfaction shifts to product impact; metrics like LOC mislead.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；心流乐趣消失，满足感转向产品影响；代码行数等指标具有误导性。

fiona.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases with async agents; need focus time and apprenticeship models.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，非工程师也能交付代码，角色边界模糊；异步智能体增加上下文切换负担，需专注时间，并采用学徒制培养新一代工程师。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，英特尔需以专用芯片和创业式团队重塑 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust and humility are central to Intel's turnaround; bad news must reach CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调客户信任与谦逊是转型核心，并主张坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are next waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他指出生成式 AI 之后的下一个浪潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，需要新计算平台与生态合作。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; CPU+GPU demand shifts.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中重新变得重要，需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary, akin to TSMC's Taiwan backing; supply chain resilience demands domestic fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他主张美国政府应成为英特尔主要股东，类似台积电与台湾政府的关系，并强调本土晶圆厂对供应链韧性的必要。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；借助同伴互评的在线课程能在规模化中实现掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动了进展，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding remains valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是瓶颈；开放权重模型增强地缘政治影响力；编程仍然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是个营销术语；缩放定律仍有效但转向合成数据和强化学习；智能体工作流带来价值。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause mass unemployment; bottom-up adoption yields small gains; top-down redesign and product management are key.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致大规模失业；自下而上的采用收益有限；自上而下的重新设计和产品管理是关键。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从意图生成像素，绕过代码和渲染。

ethanhe.en: World models require real-time interactive long-horizon video generation; robotics may be solved via virtual simulation without real-world interaction.
ethanhe.zh: 世界模型需要实时、交互、长时程的视频生成；机器人问题可能通过虚拟仿真解决，无需真实世界交互。

ethanhe.en: Video agents using language models as orchestrators will be the next big trend in generative media.
ethanhe.zh: 以语言模型为编排器的视频智能体将成为生成式媒体的下一大趋势。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; experience and expertise are crucial for effective use, as juniors often misuse it.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；经验和专业知识对有效使用至关重要，而初级人员常误用。

ethanhe.en: Human taste and genuine points of view become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality; developing your own voice is key.
ethanhe.zh: 随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和独特观点变得更加珍贵；培养自己的声音是关键。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but key; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point. Post-training gains importance.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处早期但至关重要；AGI 是平滑曲线而非突变点。后训练愈发重要。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift to misuse and overheating. Enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: AI 进步呈指数级；风险转向滥用与过热。企业级聚焦与安全目标一致。

dario.en: We're near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years. Safety is intertwined.
dario.zh: 我们正接近指数增长的尾声；‘天才之国’可能在 1-3 年内到来。安全与能力密不可分。

dario.en: Consistent: scaling laws drive progress; safety requires interpretability and proactive measures.
dario.zh: 一以贯之：缩放定律驱动进步；安全需要可解释性与主动措施。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate as insurance makes human driving costly.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；自动驾驶将因保险成本而主导，人类驾驶将变得昂贵。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and getting bored can lead to breakthrough ideas; self-care is foundational for performance.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊能带来突破性想法；自我关怀是表现的基础。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams thrive on self-management; climate tech is underinvested.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；小团队靠自我管理；气候技术投资不足。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers, not vitamins; opinion-based decisions for v1; storytelling defines product.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；v1 决策基于观点；故事定义产品。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices are companions to smartphones, not replacements; displays remain necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备是智能手机的伴侣而非替代；显示屏仍必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; prediction via filling blanks builds world models; text alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他称自监督学习为智能的暗物质，通过填空预测构建世界模型，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA architectures and open source are key; AGI gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他认为自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解，JEPA 架构和开源是关键，AGI 是渐进过程而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; world models enable planning; human-level AI in 10 years; open source essential.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 不如猫聪明，世界模型实现规划，十年内达到人类水平，开源至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with JEPA and hierarchical planning; open research; decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他称 LLM 是死胡同，世界模型结合 JEPA 和分层规划，开放研究，机器人十年到来。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; open-source is meritocratic.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险微乎其微；开源是精英主义的。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial; AI companions can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐至关重要；AI 伴侣可以普及专业知识。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本两年内下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs; AI is not conscious.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；任务自动化而非工作；AI 没有意识。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products must rethink UI for fault tolerance and place autonomy at VP level.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，产品需重新思考 UI 的容错性，并将自主权置于副总裁层级。

gustav.en: Generative AI is an instrument enabling new creators, but uniqueness becomes harder; strong opinions loosely held.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，生成式 AI 是赋能新创作者的乐器，但独特性更难；坚持强烈观点但保持开放。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work with synchronized swimming, not divide and conquer.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，长期任期建立信任与效率；职能组织通过同步协作而非分而治之运作。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent' prioritizing well-being; contrarian anti-engagement choices like disabling video.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，战略是‘时间花得值’，优先用户福祉；反共识地牺牲参与度，如允许关闭视频。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms via plain English, not increase addiction; first-mover advantage in tech shifts.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，AI 应通过自然语言让用户控制算法，而非增加成瘾性；技术变革期先发优势关键。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems should handle infrastructure internally.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体式系统应内部处理基础设施。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; CEOs must understand token capital deeply.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；CEO 必须深刻理解 token 资本。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via company hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出自动形式化比证明更难，在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调形式验证旨在扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，并能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须采用形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，Mira Murati 强调缩放定律和专注单一大型模型并非早期显而易见的选择，而持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈能提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她认为在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要，安全研究必须在公开环境中进行。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; the most advanced AI should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她提出交互模型应支持实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话；最先进的 AI 应成为思维工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调让人类参与循环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要，制度设计与透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI development toward collaboration; compressing progress leads to volatility.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为未来并非注定，我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作；压缩进展会导致波动，长期稳健进步才是关键。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进步；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools can solve hard problems but still need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples; generalization remains key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，当前模型在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化；泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Existential risk from AI is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，AI 的生存风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size is the key lever.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使得预填充比解码更便宜；批大小是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead by storing weights locally.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列通过本地存储权重减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 位宽的二次方缩放使得低精度效率远高；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla; data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute. Open source is safer due to scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，认为缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正，数据质量与效率同算力同等重要；开源因可审查而更安全。

mensch.en: Data quality is a bottleneck; algorithmic gains yield 100x efficiency. Value shifts to applications, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，强调数据质量是瓶颈，算法改进可带来百倍效率；价值向应用层转移，而非仅基础模型。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity, not a fear. Sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张将 AI 视为机遇而非风险；主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施和价值观，开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization and vertical specialization. Pre-training saturates; domain fine-tuning and agents matter.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为模型商品化，差异化在于定制与垂直专业化；预训练趋饱和，领域微调和智能体更重要。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure within two years; enterprise adoption needs ROI and human-in-the-loop agents.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调欧洲需在两年内建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用需 ROI 和人机协同智能体。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local, shared tools, and safety; scaffolding less important as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的未来在于本地化、共享工具和安全；随着模型改进，脚手架的重要性降低。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious tasks, but the real gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐任务，但真正的差距是人们意识不到几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they don't know limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，对于开放式任务使用 Opus；孩子表现出色因为他们不知道限制。

felixrieseberg.en: Custom hardware with Claude Code is accessible and cheap; AI-native kids will shape future.
felixrieseberg.zh: 使用 Claude Code 构建定制硬件既可行又便宜；AI 原生儿童将塑造未来。

felixrieseberg.en: Debug workflows with Claude, not just corrections; asynchronous interaction is ideal.
felixrieseberg.zh: 与 Claude 一起调试工作流程，而不仅仅是纠正；异步交互是理想的。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外还有巨大潜力。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must ship fast and help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速交付并协助工程师执行，而非仅仅移交模型。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; speed builds trust through early shipping and iteration.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景现在只展望 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；通过尽早发布和快速迭代建立信任。

jennywen.en: AI will improve at taste and judgment, but humans still decide what matters; designers should be block-shaped generalists.
jennywen.zh: AI 在品味和判断力上会进步，但人类仍决定什么重要；设计师应成为块状通才。

jennywen.en: Designers must adopt three archetypes: block-shaped, deep T specialist, and cracked new grad; taste alone won't save them.
jennywen.zh: 设计师必须采用三种原型：块状、深 T 专家和破解新毕业生；仅靠品味无法拯救他们。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; put work and users at center, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师控制 AI 采用；新工具等 6 个月再用；以工作和用户为中心，而非 AI 炒作。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要；安全是系统级属性，需多层防护。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance; RL with verifiable rewards boosts reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献九成性能；可验证奖励的强化学习提升推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is key for reasoning and tool use; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是推理和工具使用的关键；混合推理模型或为过渡；开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill US vacuum; openness is strategic and ideological.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：开放模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补美国空白；开放性兼具战略与意识形态意义。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling persists but less cost-effective; RLVR is biggest breakthrough; open models drive next decade of research.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效但性价比降低；RLVR 是最大突破；开放模型驱动未来十年研究。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and safe emergent behaviors.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类安全需要雷达和激光雷达；AV 3.0 可能将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，扩展通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和世界模型；消费车辆将超越机器人出租车规模。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；跨 500 多个城市的零样本泛化成为可能。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks in real-world use.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在真实使用中学习和缓解风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；仅强化学习就足够（2026）。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏它可保持可解释性（2026）。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days; biggest risk is power concentration from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天；最大风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中（2026）。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain critical; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build things themselves to inspire teams; AI integration is at its very start.
dylanfield.zh: 领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；AI 整合才刚刚开始。

dylanfield.en: Despite role merging talk, we see merging of responsibilities, not roles; human judgment remains essential.
dylanfield.zh: 尽管有角色融合的说法，我们看到的是职责的融合而非角色的融合；人类判断仍然至关重要。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；通过蒸馏，认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, prompts are programs; build partial autonomy with human verification; decade of agents.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 是操作系统，提示词是程序；构建带人工验证的部分自主；智能体时代是十年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is weak, synthetic data collapses; cognitive core stripped of memory is small.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非构建动物；强化学习薄弱，合成数据会崩溃；剥离记忆的认知核心很小。

karpathy.en: I haven't coded since December; agents do all coding; bottleneck is directing them; agent-first tools and markdown for agents.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我不再写代码；智能体负责编码；瓶颈在于指挥它们；工具应智能体优先，为智能体写 Markdown。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我强调基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 我始终认为，像代码这样可验证的领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进步需要由老练、有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models to align with its thesis.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，塑造出多样化的 AI；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合其理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize over accuracy, with omission being a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要；安全应优先于准确性，遗漏是关键风险。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the real challenge is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. We should not align AI to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可发展，控制 AI 目标反而危险，不应将 AI 对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他构想 AGI 应具备无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models remains unsolved.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申学习“利于学习的表征”是首要未解问题，基于学习模型的规划也仍未解决。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型即产品，需像软件一样每日迭代、快速发布，以真实反馈驱动改进。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; AI will render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为对话不是终局，AI 将生成自有界面并融入现有工具，类似从 MS-DOS 到 Windows 的演进。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他主张安全与产品速度分离：前沿模型严格把关，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, and model gains.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他将北极星指标定为长期留存，增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资与模型改进三方面。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为服务下十亿用户需超越聊天机器人，打造主动且功能丰富的产品。

nando.en: AI should augment human abilities, like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest open challenges; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues and contribute uniquely.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大的开放挑战，非洲可跨越遗留问题并做出独特贡献。

nando.en: Emphasizes diversity, inclusion, and human skills (communication) as essential for building beneficial AI.
nando.zh: 始终强调多样性、包容性和人类技能（如沟通）对构建有益 AI 至关重要。

nando.en: Shifted from excitement about scaling and generalist agents to prioritizing safety and societal impact.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对规模扩张和通用智能体的兴奋，转向 2026 年优先关注安全和社会影响。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升智能；微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI. Agents' bottleneck is reliability, not capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调语言模型上的强化学习没有上限，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI；智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; models learn new skills via RL, not just elicit. Alignment faking raises safety concerns.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键，模型能通过强化学习习得新能力而非仅激发已有知识；对齐伪装引发安全担忧。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; RL is a new scaling axis. Longer agentic coherence expands achievements. Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我坚信进展是指数级的，强化学习是新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性大幅扩展成就；Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang is massive; orchestration matters more than raw intelligence. Compute is the bottleneck; world models not critical.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩严重，编排比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在关键路径上。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，强调设计师应通过编码建立同理心并加速交付，优先追求速度和熟悉感而非创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌战略应聚焦招聘和差异化，品牌指南应是动态平台而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and brand narrative attracts talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，将设计提升为战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用，品牌叙事成为吸引人才的关键。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; avoid structured crits; adapt process to problem; gut beats data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆，避免结构化评审，流程因问题而异，直觉优于数据。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师并聚焦问题来推动工作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, fluctuating and paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，会波动，并与技术债务一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Treat AI as a creative partner; jam with it openly without rigid structure.
nadchishtie.zh: 将 AI 视为创意伙伴，开放地与其即兴合作，不拘泥于固定结构。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作的，代码作为事实来源。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will shift software to outcome-based pricing; coding becomes operating code-generating machines.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 智能体将推动软件转向基于结果的定价；编程变为操作代码生成机器。

brettaylor.en: Frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业应聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience will be as important as websites or mobile apps.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：用于客户体验的 AI 智能体将变得与网站或移动应用同等重要。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases and business models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本将大幅下降，催生新的用例和商业模式。

brettaylor.en: Most enterprise incumbents will fail to transition to AI-native business models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：大多数企业级现有厂商将无法转型为 AI 原生的商业模式。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的算法和数据，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all AI methods reduce to data, and current methods interpolate human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我越来越强调数据是根本瓶颈，所有 AI 方法都归结为数据，而当前方法只是对人类知识的内插。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为强化学习需要精心设计；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 有所提升。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; small models with diverse synthetic data can match frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张多元对齐优于消除互联网偏见；通过多样化的合成数据，小模型可以媲美前沿模型。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高昂。

truell.en: Scaling laws drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律推动可预测的 AI 进步；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍处于主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost; every magic moment involves them.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本上；每个神奇时刻都离不开它们。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research under-explored; PhD path; talent gap bigger than funding.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究不足，博士路径，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight; interpretability key; automated alignment research; model organisms.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 无法扩展，需要可扩展监督，可解释性关键，自动化对齐研究，模型生物。

leike.en: OpenAI safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; third-party testing needed; raising cost of misuse.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，后训练不足，需第三方测试，提高滥用成本。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling compute and data improves intelligence, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的，扩大算力和数据能提升智能，但模型内部机制仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are key near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期关键机会，模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）可实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据；持续学习与模块化组件或可取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped economically; coding is underhyped as it enables self-acceleration; open-source models are closing the gap.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出 AGI 的经济影响被低估，编码应用被低估（因其加速 AI 自身发展），开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。
